name: My Indian Kitchen

name: Indilicious

name: Akshayapatra Online / Sri SAI Essentials
business_type: Grocery / Indian Food Retail / Online Retail
founder_kerala_connection: No credible evidence found that the owners are from Kerala; Kerala connection is through the explicitly offered Kerala grocery/product range.
research_notes: Online Indian grocery retailer based in Eindhoven delivering across the Netherlands. Its public content explicitly markets Kerala groceries/products, making it relevant to the retail ecosystem, but ownership connection to Kerala is not established.

name: Indian Sweet Lovers
research_notes: Home-based Indian sweets, snacks and event catering in Amsterdam. Strong sweets/snacks evidence, but products found were predominantly North Indian rather than Kerala-specific, so Kerala connection remains unverified.
